usage: General GATE EE/EC pre-exam refresher formulas and rapid checks, not official exam questions or keys

packs.subject: Engineering Mathematics
packs.title: Matrices: rank, eigenvalues, invertibility
packs.pitfall: A nonzero determinant requires a square matrix. Repeated eigenvalues do not automatically imply two eigenvectors.
packs.question: If a 3×3 matrix has rank 2, what is its nullity?

packs.subject: Engineering Mathematics
packs.title: Projection and least squares
packs.pitfall: Check the full-column-rank condition before using the inverse; otherwise use a pseudoinverse.
packs.question: For a least-squares residual r=b−A x̂, what equals zero?
packs.answer: Aᵀr=0 (the residual is orthogonal to the column space).

packs.subject: Engineering Mathematics
packs.title: Conditional probability and expectation
packs.pitfall: At least one success is 1−P(none). For conditional questions, reduce the sample space first.
packs.question: If Y=2X+3 and Var(X)=4, find Var(Y).
packs.answer: 16. The constant shift has no effect; multiply the variance by 2².

packs.subject: Engineering Mathematics
packs.title: Complex variables: Cauchy and residues
packs.pitfall: The contour must enclose the relevant singularity, be positively oriented, and satisfy the theorem's analyticity conditions.
packs.question: What is the CCW integral of 1/(z−2) around |z|=1?

packs.subject: Engineering Mathematics
packs.title: Calculus and differential equations
packs.pitfall: A Bernoulli differential equation needs substitution before the linear integrating-factor formula.
packs.question: What is the integrating factor of y′+2y=x?

packs.subject: Signals & Systems
packs.title: Fourier transform essentials
packs.pitfall: Use the specified Fourier transform convention. For real x(t): X(−jω)=X*(jω).
packs.question: If x(t) shifts right by t₀, what multiplies X(jω)?

packs.subject: Signals & Systems
packs.title: Fourier series and Parseval
packs.pitfall: For real signals, ±k harmonic powers occur in pairs. Do not mix energy Parseval (Fourier transform) with average-power Parseval (Fourier series).
packs.question: A real periodic signal has c₁=c₋₁=2, all other cₖ=0. What is its power?

packs.subject: Signals & Systems
packs.title: Z-transform, ROC and stability
packs.pitfall: ROC must exclude poles; stability requires the unit circle to belong to the ROC. The same algebraic X(z) can have different inverse signals for different ROCs.
packs.question: For x[n]=(0.5)ⁿu[n], is the unit circle in the ROC?

packs.subject: Signals & Systems
packs.title: Laplace ROC and causality
packs.pitfall: For a rational causal LTI system, ROC is to the right of the rightmost pole. Stability requires the jω axis in the ROC.
packs.question: For e^(−2t)u(t), what is the bilateral Laplace ROC?

packs.subject: Signals & Systems
packs.title: Sampling, Nyquist and DFT
packs.pitfall: Time compression expands frequency bandwidth; time expansion reduces it. Two physical frequencies can alias to the same discrete frequency.
packs.question: A signal bandlimited to 5 kHz needs which ideal minimum sampling rate?

packs.subject: Signals & Systems
packs.title: Convolution and LTI response
packs.pitfall: Impulse response determines the output only for an LTI system; check linearity and time invariance first.
packs.question: If x[n]=δ[n−3], what is y[n] for an LTI h[n]?

packs.subject: Network Theory
packs.title: Thevenin, Norton and max power
packs.pitfall: Keep dependent sources active when finding RTh; use a test source when needed.
packs.question: For RTh=4 Ω, what resistive RL maximizes power?

packs.subject: Network Theory
packs.title: KCL, node voltages and sources
packs.pitfall: A voltage source between two nonreference nodes creates a supernode; include its voltage constraint.
packs.question: Two currents of 2 A and 3 A enter a node. What total current leaves?

packs.subject: Network Theory
packs.title: AC phasors, resonance and power
packs.pitfall: Use rms quantities for average power; use the correct sign of capacitor reactance.
packs.question: If R=3 Ω and XL=4 Ω in series, what is |Z|?

packs.subject: Network Theory
packs.title: RC/RL switching and time constants
packs.pitfall: Capacitor voltage and inductor current cannot change instantaneously in ordinary finite-energy circuits.
packs.question: How much of the initial exponential difference remains after one time constant?

packs.subject: Network Theory
packs.title: Two-port Z and Y parameters
packs.pitfall: Both port currents are conventionally defined entering the network. Sign errors can reverse off-diagonal entries.
packs.question: What is y₁₂?

packs.subject: Network Theory
packs.title: Three-phase circuit shortcuts
packs.pitfall: Do not mix star and delta line-to-phase conversions.
packs.question: For balanced unity-PF load, VL=400 V, IL=10 A. Total P?

packs.subject: Analog Electronics
packs.title: Ideal op-amps and feedback
packs.pitfall: The virtual-short rule only applies with negative feedback in linear operation. Positive feedback often drives saturation.
packs.question: Inverting amplifier: Rin=2 kΩ, Rf=10 kΩ. Gain?

packs.subject: Analog Electronics
packs.title: MOSFETs, BJTs and device bias
packs.pitfall: The square-law model assumes long-channel saturation and neglects channel-length modulation; check region before applying.
packs.question: When an nMOS just reaches saturation, what is VDS?

packs.subject: Analog Electronics
packs.title: Filters and bandwidth
packs.pitfall: The −3 dB level means amplitude ×0.707, not half amplitude.
packs.question: A first-order RC low-pass has R=1 kΩ, C=1 μF. Cutoff?

packs.subject: Digital Electronics
packs.title: Boolean algebra, CMOS and MUX
packs.pitfall: Check whether the MUX enable is active-low. For CMOS gate networks, series and parallel transistor paths are dual.
packs.question: How many select lines for an 8:1 MUX?

packs.subject: Digital Electronics
packs.title: Flip-flops, timing and state machines
packs.pitfall: Hold-time checks are separate from setup-time checks. State-machine overlapping sequences may restart in a noninitial state.
packs.question: For 2 ns clock-to-Q, 4 ns logic, 1 ns setup, find fmax.

packs.subject: Digital Electronics
packs.title: Binary codes, ADC and DAC
packs.pitfall: Some full-range calibration questions use 2ᴺ−1 steps instead of 2ᴺ; follow the paper's stated convention.
packs.question: An 8-bit ideal 0–8 V DAC uses 256 equal codes. LSB?

packs.subject: Power Electronics
packs.title: Rectifiers and controlled converters
packs.pitfall: The formula assumes ideal switches and continuous current without overlap. Discontinuous load current changes the answer.
packs.question: For α=90° in the ideal continuous-current formula, average Vdc?

packs.subject: Electrical Machines
packs.title: Machine speed, slip and back EMF
packs.pitfall: Induction-motor rotor speed is below synchronous speed in motor operation. For DC motors, speed roughly follows E/Φ.
packs.question: A 4-pole, 50 Hz induction motor runs at 1440 rpm. Slip?

packs.subject: Power Systems
packs.title: Power systems: flows and dispatch
packs.pitfall: PV bus: P and |V| specified, not Q. Keep generation/load signs and transformer tap effects consistent.
packs.question: What is specified at an ordinary PV bus?
packs.answer: Active power P and voltage magnitude |V|.

packs.subject: Control Systems
packs.title: Control stability and steady-state error
packs.pitfall: The ramp formula assumes stable unity negative feedback and finite position/velocity constants as appropriate.
packs.question: A type-1 unity-feedback system has Kv=20 s⁻¹. Unit-ramp error?

packs.subject: Electromagnetics
packs.title: Fields and transmission lines
packs.pitfall: Do not confuse voltage reflection coefficient Γ with power reflectance |Γ|².
packs.question: If |Γ|=0.5, VSWR?

packs.subject: Communication Systems
packs.title: Modulation, SNR and bandwidth
packs.pitfall: Convert SNR in dB to a linear ratio before Shannon's expression.
packs.question: An 8-bit PCM sampler at 10 kHz has what raw bit rate?

packs.subject: Engineering Mathematics
packs.title: Positive definite matrices
packs.pitfall: Eigenvalue criterion applies to a real symmetric matrix; use the Hermitian analogue for complex matrices.
packs.question: If a symmetric matrix has eigenvalues 2 and −1, is it positive definite?

packs.subject: Engineering Mathematics
packs.title: Diagonalization and eigenvectors
packs.pitfall: Repeated eigenvalues need not have enough independent eigenvectors for diagonalization.
packs.question: Is every real symmetric matrix diagonalizable?
packs.answer: Yes, by an orthogonal matrix (spectral theorem).

packs.subject: Engineering Mathematics
packs.title: Bayes' theorem and independence
packs.pitfall: Independence and mutual exclusivity are different. For nonzero probabilities they cannot both hold.
packs.question: If P(A)=0.3 and P(B)=0.4, independent: P(A∩B)?

packs.subject: Engineering Mathematics
packs.title: Analyticity and Cauchy–Riemann
packs.pitfall: Cauchy–Riemann at an isolated point alone does not prove analyticity throughout a neighbourhood.
packs.question: Is f(z)=|z|² analytic on an open set?

packs.subject: Network Theory
packs.title: Superposition and dependent sources
packs.pitfall: Suppress independent voltage sources by shorting and independent current sources by opening. Do not suppress dependent sources.
packs.question: When checking the effect of one current source, what replaces another independent ideal current source?

packs.subject: Network Theory
packs.title: Series RLC resonance and Q factor
packs.pitfall: Series resonance cancels reactance but leaves resistance; in parallel RLC current and impedance trends differ.
packs.question: At series resonance, what is input impedance of ideal series RLC?

packs.subject: Analog Electronics
packs.title: Op-amp slew rate and gain bandwidth
packs.pitfall: Slew-rate distortion is a large-signal constraint, distinct from small-signal closed-loop bandwidth.
packs.question: For a 1 V peak sine at 1 MHz, minimum slew rate?

packs.subject: Analog Electronics
packs.title: Diodes: bias and small-signal resistance
packs.pitfall: The small-signal resistance is the inverse slope at the DC operating point, not the DC ratio V/I.
packs.question: If diode current doubles at fixed temperature, what happens to r_d approximately?

packs.subject: Analog Electronics
packs.title: Differential amplifier fundamentals
packs.pitfall: CMRR is a gain ratio (often quoted in dB); do not mistake it for differential gain alone.
packs.question: For Ad=1000 and Acm=0.1, CMRR?

packs.subject: Digital Electronics
packs.title: Karnaugh maps and minimization
packs.pitfall: Adjacent K-map cells differ in only one variable. Groups must have sizes 1, 2, 4, 8, …; wrap-around adjacency is allowed.
packs.question: How many minterms in a Boolean function of 4 variables?

packs.subject: Digital Electronics
packs.title: Counters and flip-flop requirements
packs.pitfall: A MOD-10 counter needs 4 flip-flops, but 6 of its 16 possible states are unused.
packs.question: Minimum flip-flops for MOD-13 counter?

packs.subject: Signals & Systems
packs.title: Time scaling and frequency-domain effects
packs.pitfall: Compressing a signal in time expands its spectrum in frequency. Include the 1/|a| amplitude factor.
packs.question: For x(2t), what is its Fourier transform?

packs.subject: Signals & Systems
packs.title: Energy signals and Parseval's theorem
packs.pitfall: A nonzero finite-amplitude periodic continuous-time signal generally has infinite energy but finite average power.
packs.question: Does a nonzero sine wave over all time have finite energy?
packs.answer: No; infinite energy and finite average power.

packs.subject: Power Electronics
packs.title: DC–DC converters: buck and boost
packs.pitfall: These formulas assume steady-state continuous-conduction mode and ideal switching. They do not apply unchanged in DCM.
packs.question: An ideal buck converter has D=0.4, Vin=20 V. Output?

packs.subject: Power Electronics
packs.title: Three-phase diode bridge rectifiers
packs.pitfall: The 1.35 factor is for an ideal three-phase full bridge with continuous DC current and negligible overlap.
packs.question: At 50 Hz mains, six-pulse ripple frequency?

packs.subject: Electrical Machines
packs.title: Transformer EMF and turns ratio
packs.pitfall: Use peak flux Φmax, not rms flux. Copper and leakage effects make terminal and induced voltage differ on load.
packs.question: If turns ratio N1/N2=2, ideal secondary voltage for 230 V primary?

packs.subject: Electrical Machines
packs.title: Induction motor rotor power flow
packs.pitfall: Developed mechanical power is before friction and windage; shaft output is lower.
packs.question: For air-gap power 10 kW and slip 4%, rotor copper loss?

packs.subject: Power Systems
packs.title: Symmetrical components
packs.pitfall: In a balanced positive-sequence system the zero-sequence component is zero. Phase rotation matters.
packs.question: For three balanced phasors 120° apart, Va+Vb+Vc?

packs.subject: Power Systems
packs.title: Power factor correction and capacitor sizing
packs.pitfall: A capacitor changes reactive power but does not directly reduce required real load power.
packs.question: If Q before=100 kVAr and Q after=30 kVAr, required capacitor reactive power?

packs.subject: Control Systems
packs.title: Routh–Hurwitz stability test
packs.pitfall: Special cases such as zero first-column elements or a zero row need auxiliary procedures; don't ignore them.
packs.question: If a Routh array's first column has two sign changes, how many RHP roots?

packs.subject: Control Systems
packs.title: Root locus geometry
packs.pitfall: For positive K, real-axis segments are on the root locus when the number of real open-loop poles and zeros to their right is odd.
packs.question: With 3 poles and 1 finite zero, how many asymptotes?

packs.subject: Communication Systems
packs.title: AM and FM bandwidth basics
packs.pitfall: Carson's rule approximates significant FM bandwidth; it is not a strict bandlimit.
packs.question: Conventional AM with highest modulating frequency 5 kHz needs how much bandwidth?

packs.subject: Electromagnetics
packs.title: Poynting vector and wave impedance
packs.pitfall: Poynting vector is power flux density; for time-harmonic fields the average uses (1/2)Re{E×H*} with peak phasors.
packs.question: For a free-space plane wave E=377 V/m rms, H rms?

sourceNote: General GATE EE/EC formula reminders, not original GATE/ACE questions; topic priority calculated locally from authentic submitted CBT grading and separately labelled qualitative practice flags.
